annotations.title: SEBI CSCRF category for a regulated entity

description: Works out a SEBI regulated entity’s CSCRF category (MII, Qualified, Mid-size, Small-size, Self-certification or Exempt) from the current thresholds, and the obligations that category carries. Call with only entity_type to see which figures it needs. Boundary values the circulars leave uncategorised are reported as such, not guessed.
